redfin.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in the highly desirable Temple City community. Situated on a quiet, peaceful street, this charming residence offers a versatile floor plan with modern updates and an abundance of natural light . The main level features a bright and inviting living room with a large picture window, a spacious formal dining room, and a well-appointed kitchen with an island and adjoining dining area—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The convenient downstairs primary suite offers comfort and privacy, while a separate bonus room with its own bathroom and private entrance provides excellent flexibility for guests, a home office, extended family, or potential rental use. The property offers ample parking, including a detached two-car garage . The south-facing orientation enhances the home's natural light, while views toward the San Gabriel Mountains add to its appeal. The backyard provides a peaceful outdoor setting complete with a mature pomegranate tree . Ideally located near parks, shopping, dining, and highly regarded schools within the Temple City School District, this move-in-ready home presents a wonderful opportunity in one of the area's most sought-after communities. Adding to its unique character, the property was featured in the film Never Been Kissed, starring Drew Barrymore. A truly special Temple City home with charm, flexibility, and a memorable history—don't miss it!
